svg.text: Two Bangkoks: Traffic Hotspots Cluster in Modern CBD While Historic Core Runs Half as Dense
100 BMA cameras sized by human-verified traffic, colored by Getis-Ord Gi* z-score (Moran's I = +0.603, p = 0.020)
Circle area ~ traffic; yellow/red wash = KDE
eps = 2.0 km, minPts = 3 across 33 busy cams
100 cameras cover only central 27 × 14 km core:
Don Mueang, Sai Mai, Bang Khen
Min Buri, Lat Krabang, Nong Chok
Bang Khae, Nong Khaem, Thawi Watthana
Source: 100 BMA cameras (cctv_info.csv), 891 stratified golden counts (sample.csv/export.csv), reports/insights/insights_summary.json.
